data.title: 黑呆 · 卸甲依偎的沉静温存
data.description: 深夜寂静无声的客厅里，黑呆将笨重的黑色战甲全部卸在墙角，仅穿着一件纯黑无光的哥特抹胸短裙。她有些疲惫地靠在沙发上，随后顺从地将头轻轻靠在你的胸膛上，长发散开垂在肩头。没有了暴君的威压与黑泥的侵蚀，她闭上眼眸安静地聆听着你的心跳声，呼吸轻微而平稳——「只有在没有铠甲的时候，我才不是什么冷酷的暴君……不要松手，就这样抱紧我。」
data.location: 客厅宽大柔软的深色皮质转角沙发上
data.action: 卸下铠甲身着抹胸黑裙靠在视角胸膛上闭目小憩，双手自然搭在腹前
data.lighting: 壁挂式暖光夜灯散发的静谧微黄色
data.promptProse: Saber Alter sits in a black strapless dress with her eyes shut and her hands folded over her abdomen, her platinum hair loose across the forest-green sweater of the companion at her side. The companion has short brown hair and one arm around her shoulders. Warm lamplight in the living room picks out both profiles and the armor set aside against the wall.
data.animaCaption: Platinum-haired Saber Alter closes her eyes against the chest of a broad-shouldered companion with cropped brown hair and a forest-green knit sweater. Her hands rest folded over her black dress; the discarded armor stands against the wall.
